representative_request: Design a complete high-end portfolio experience for an independent multidisciplinary designer, with realistic placeholder content and credible work browsing, project depth, positioning, and contact path.
adequacy_evidence: A coherent overview-to-selection-to-case-study-to-next-action experience; not a hero or project grid alone.

representative_request: Design a high-fidelity product marketing experience for a new research tool using realistic placeholder claims clearly marked as placeholders, showing the product mechanism, decision evidence, and a credible next action.
adequacy_evidence: The proposition, mechanism, evidence, objections, product demonstration, and action form one persuasive progression without fabricated proof.

representative_request: Design a dense analyst dashboard for comparing regional error rates, finding anomalies, understanding denominators and freshness, and drilling into affected records.
adequacy_evidence: Overview, comparison, filter scope, uncertainty, anomaly diagnosis, and record-level path support the stated decision at realistic density.

representative_request: Design a high-fidelity project workspace where a small team can organize work, inspect a task, update status, recover from mistakes, and understand activity without losing context.
adequacy_evidence: The object model, navigation, primary workspace, detail/edit behavior, feedback, undo/recovery, and empty/error conditions form a credible operating experience.

representative_request: Design an iPhone reading-list flow for adding a link, browsing saved items, reading, resuming, and recovering from a failed save, with larger text and one-handed use.
adequacy_evidence: The connected add, list, read, return/resume, and failure-recovery states work as a mobile experience rather than isolated screens.

representative_request: Design a high-end editorial experience for a collection of long-form essays, including discovery, an article at realistic length, section finding, resumption, attribution, and a coherent next-read path.
adequacy_evidence: Collection-to-article-to-navigation/resume-to-next-read behavior supports comprehension and orientation beyond a styled opening viewport.
